Class AbstractBatchGetBuilder<T, S extends AbstractBatchGetBuilder<T,S>>

java.lang.Object
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.builder.base.AbstractBatchGetBuilder<T,S>
Type Parameters:
T - the item type
S - the concrete builder type (for fluent chaining)
Direct Known Subclasses:
AsyncBatchGetBuilder, BatchGetBuilder
public abstract class AbstractBatchGetBuilder<T, S extends AbstractBatchGetBuilder<T,S>> extends Object
Abstract base for sync and async batch get builders.
